project.name: Porch Light
project.summary: A care-facility outreach workbench: on https://porchlight.earth an operator opens a published US county and gets a deterministically ranked call sheet, source gaps, and stored free-route Nemotron drafts where the national sweep wrote them. The hosted pack (sweep 20261023T200048Z-78a426ba, generated 2026-10-24T16:47:04Z) has 3,235 catalog counties, 3,234 snapshots, and 2,490 counties with ranked facilities (15,440 rows: 14,960 passed drafts at actual cost 0, 480 failed and retained). Robertson County, Texas has no published snapshot. New model calls stay on local origin. Nemotron does not rank.

builders.name: Joe Gaither
builders.role: owner: decides, reviews and merges; agents write the code

zetaris.how: Audited Zetaris SQL joins CMS, Census, SVI, and emPOWER in one read-only PostGIS datasource. The hosted desk serves frozen snapshots from sweep 20261023T200048Z-78a426ba. Catalog query id 833. Each published county sheet cites its own chain query ids. Spatial predicates stay in PostGIS. A Unified Semantic Layer across multiple live physical systems is not claimed.
data_sources: porchlight_postgis: read-only PostgreSQL/PostGIS source containing captured public records and pre-joined exports

meterless.how: Runtime model calls use meterless/deep through local Nightshift, thinking disabled. Scout Intent (engines/scout_intent.py) gates the local call-script path: it classifies the request, binds the facility CCN, and issues an HMAC-SHA256 execution contract. The draft executor refuses unsigned, tampered, expired, or out-of-scope contracts before a provider call. The hosted desk does not start a model call: POST /api/national returns 403. Stored explanation drafts in the published pack are the evidence a judge sees there. Batch explanation drafts are not contract-gated. engines/openrouter_backup.py can retry one failed call_script on the same Nemotron id only when PORCHLIGHT_OPENROUTER_BACKUP and OPENROUTER_API_KEY are set. Every explanation execution in the published pack has paid_fallback_enabled false. That backup is not the demo path. H-MEM, World Model, Markovian, and local model execution are not claimed.

cursor.how: Cursor cloud agents wrote Storm Watch and the Storm Glass Desk (PR #22), the national county and alert web wiring (PR #24), and the nationwide-first home (PR #47). Cursor also supplies the .cursor/rules/ files. Devin wrote the contract (PR #14), the data, the engines, and most of the web. Joe directed the work. No token count or spend is recorded.

nvidia.how: Two Nemotron ids appear in the published county snapshots and in retained receipts, both requested as meterless/deep with thinking disabled: nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b and nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-120b-a12b. Recount of web/data/national/published/counties: 14,960 ranked rows with explanation status passed, provider nvidia, actual_usd 0; 480 rows failed and retained. 4,098 explanation_batch executions: 3,229 reported Lightning, 773 reported Super VL, 96 with no reported model. The hosted desk shows those stored drafts. It does not call the model. One local call-script receipt (CCN 102853, actual_usd 0, Lightning) is engines/reports/scout-intent-live-2026-10-23.json. Nemotron does not rank. Local GPU, offline DGX, Parse, and Content Safety are not demonstrated. Not every county has an accepted draft.

run.setup: Judges can open https://porchlight.earth/nationwide with no credentials and read published county snapshots (docs/quickstart.mdx). The Milton retrospective at /operate renders from web/data/manatee-ranked.json. A fresh Zetaris chain, a captured alert, and a new call script need the local stack in README.md Setup. Nemotron stays on the Meterless Nightshift route. Model POST on the public host returns 403.

evidence_logs: Hosted county snapshots in web/data/national/published/ retain Zetaris query ids and Meterless model executions from sweep 20261023T200048Z-78a426ba. engines/reports/scout-intent-live-2026-10-23.json is the retained local call-script receipt. Scout Intent decisions on a local machine append to ~/.porchlight/scout-intent/events.jsonl.
